scope: One 2026-08-16 12 UTC six-hour forecast; hourly precipitation increments at +1..+6 h over the frozen 3,688 RN1 points.

C.input_required: new actual B1 grouped six-hour history

D.input_required: new actual DM065 grouped six-hour history

benchmark.name: ORIGINAL
benchmark.meaning: immutable 규준실험 benchmark, outside the factorial 2x2; never relabel as an arm or rerun/modify

design.historical_comparability: A/B cache reuse is conditional on native owner verifying identical source identity, initialization/input lineage, valid-time bounds, precip fields, domain/mapping, and one-hour differencing; until verified, A/B rows are labeled historical cache / comparability pending.

grouped_history_boundary.precipitation: Per-window increment of RAINC + RAINNC; never cumulative 12–lead total. Check RAINSH/bucket/reset contracts as bound by the canonical scorer.

evaluation.paired_mask: exact frozen RN1 mask and point order; reject any empty/partial/misaligned threshold or lead cohort; all five arms must share the same 3,688 sample keys at every lead.
evaluation.score_grid: Every case x lead_hour 1..6 x threshold_mm: H, M, F, correct_dry, N, exact CSI numerator=H and denominator=H+M+F plus float CSI, POD, FAR, frequency_bias, ETS; continuous mean forecast/reference/error, MAE, RMSE by case and lead.
evaluation.exact_CSI: Compute only from integer H/M/F for each individual lead-threshold cell. Never average CSI across thresholds or leads for gates or factorial contrasts.

protection.cells: lead +1 at all six thresholds plus all six leads at 5 mm; deduplicate overlap to 11 unique cells
protection.rule: Both grouped candidates are separately compared with the same immutable A oldsum current-B1 baseline in each cell using exact integer-ratio comparison.

recovery.rule: Both grouped candidates are separately compared with the same immutable ORIGINAL benchmark in each cell using exact integer-ratio comparison.

frozen_gates.scope: Each candidate has its own 26-cell pass/fail result. No averaging and no gate movement. If neither passes, retain current B1.

contrasts.C_minus_A: Grouped-history contrast under current B1 configuration.
contrasts.difference_in_differences: (D-B)-(C-A), per lead/threshold for each score/count, diagnostic interaction on the score scale; not causal process attribution or percent contribution.
contrasts.contrast_measure: Report exact H/M/F deltas, exact CSI cell values and differences; derive CSI differences from cell ratios, not averaged CSI.

transition_audit.weak_observation: 0.1 <= RN1 < 1.0 mm; for the >=0.1 mm detection decision report hits gained/lost, all conditional on weak-observation cells.
transition_audit.dry_observation: RN1 < 0.1 mm; report newly introduced and resolved >=0.1 mm false alarms.
transition_audit.scope: Per lead and paired point; these population-specific transitions supplement full-cohort H/M/F and do not redefine CSI.

candidate_selection.eligible_only_after: all 26 frozen cells pass for that candidate
candidate_selection.priority: lexicographically maximize exact per-cell CSI at +1 h/10 mm, then +2..+6 h/10 mm in chronological order, then +1..+6 h/5 mm in chronological order
candidate_selection.tie_break: complete tie prefers C (current B1 grouped; preserves B1 initial rain-number field)
candidate_selection.forbidden: CSI averages or composite mean scores

input_contract.new_histories: Require all arms C,D histories at exact 12–18 UTC boundaries with identity/hash receipts; strict date/time, one-hour windows, precipitation accumulation monotonicity/reset, dimensions/grid and field validation.
input_contract.existing_cache_reuse: Historical arrays may be loaded only after native owner comparability receipt is attached; source cache hash and the full original source receipt must remain bound.
input_contract.canonical_RN1: Verify all six unique lead-time files by exact SHA-256; the filenames and hashes below are canonical inputs, not substitutes for observations.
input_contract.atomic_output: Refuse an existing output path; write staged outputs in a same-filesystem temporary directory and atomically publish all outputs; clean staging on failure.
input_contract.provenance: Receipts include source input identity/hash, scorer version hash, canonical references, point-key hash/order, history boundary, model fields and output hashes.

tables: categorical_scores.csv (5 cases x 6 leads x 6 thresholds = 180 rows)
contrasts.csv (C-A,D-B,B-A,D-C,DiD x 6 leads x 6 thresholds; count and exact CSI deltas)
weak_transition_counts.csv (lead x C-A,D-B,B-A,D-C; weak hit gains/losses and dry new/resolved FAs)
gate_results.csv (52 rows: 26 frozen cells separately for C and D against shared A/ORIGINAL baselines)
winner.json (exact cellwise eligible-candidate tie policy and retain-B1 outcome)
output_schema.hour_arrays: One archive per lead with reference and all five arms, geographic/key arrays, and point keys; all vectors are length 3688 and finite.

graphify_navigation.query: Hourly precip scoring arrays from WRF history and RN1, exact count gates and transition summaries
graphify_navigation.authority_note: Navigation only; implementation and numeric validation must follow source, exact input receipts, and tests.

limitations: Single event / single case; RN1 is a processed analysis with no coverage bitmap and upstream input freshness is unverified.
The 2x2 contrasts compare score patterns and do not establish isolated microphysical causality.
Do not present the difference-in-differences as causal attribution or a percent contribution.
The historical A/B factorial identities remain unverified until the designated native owner signs the comparability evidence.
Eligibility is evaluated separately for C and D against the same frozen current-B1 and ORIGINAL baselines; D-vs-B is diagnostic factorial contrast, not the preservation gate.
